posts.title: Metaphors: Powerful or Dangerous?
posts.description: I’m down a rabbit hole these days thinking about images, metaphors and frameworks. I suppose it is not surprising given my work on this Collection. My current dive was prompted by pieces by Dave Snowden and Mike Jackson about the problems with some common metaphors like the blind men and the elephant and the iceberg. ... Read more
